title: Doohickeyathingamobober
description: A simple minecraft mod that adds various creatures (for your features) and a new potion effect!
body:
# STUFF!
A Minecraft mod dedicated to adding..stuff!


# Mobs
### The Huhh
The Huhh is a passive, but indestructible chicken-esque mob. It doesn't attack, and poses no threat.

### Timmy
Timmy is another mob, taking on the appearance of a creeper. It shouldn't attack, but if it does **you cannot damage it in any way.**

### The Weird
The Weird is a humanoid-esque mob. It naturally spawns along your world (alongside the other mobs). Works perfectly as a pseudo-mob test subject!

# Biomes
### The Huhhhhhh Biome

The Huhhhh biome is a biome (go figure) made entirely of gold blocks. It also serves as a good source of bone blocks and harbors the new mobs added.
